fixtures.budget_note: The seven 1048576-byte values are synthetic parser fixtures only; they are not real acceptance budgets, measured storage requirements, or budgets certified for real extraction.

plan.encoding: canonical ASCII TSV with final LF
plan.partial_encrypted_sections: declared-skip; mandatory in the PLAN only, immediately between decryption and collision-storage
plan.requested_map: absent; no requested_map or substitute field is admitted
plan.requested_map_zero: rejected; zero is not an all-map sentinel
plan.db2_entries: exactly one canonical Map DB2 entry; no other table

package.manifest: forever-package.json with deterministic per-table partial-section declarations only
package.partial_encrypted_tables: Use the v26/v27 per-table declaration contract for selected Map with TACT-declared available-source sections: deterministic [{lookup, frame_ordinal, decoded_size}] bound to dbc/<locale>/Map.db2. A complete table has no declaration.
package.partial_encrypted_sections: forbidden in the package manifest; the same-named PLAN gate remains mandatory
package.global_partial_encrypted_sections: forbidden; no global or package-wide declaration is admitted
package.declaration_boundary: Only per-table partial_encrypted_tables declarations for selected Map are admitted. Resume rejects recovered global declarations and foreign tables before producer replay or final sealing.
package.present_empty_maps: A present active map with no placements retains tree and empty proof, distinct from WDT or WMO-doodad omission.
package.root_absent_maps: Every WDT ROOT-absent active map remains in Coverage.maps without tree, proof, tile or model artifacts.
package.omitted_doodads: Each declared WMO doodad M2 FDID has zero child model_reads and no model handle, VMO, NameBinding, valid name or spawn. The present WMO root retains its VMO and WMO placement, and every present doodad keeps its own VMO/binding/spawn. Direct ADT M2 placements are never filtered by this policy.

coverage_codec.domain_map_fact_root_absent: bool; encoded 0 means Present and encoded 1 means RootAbsent
coverage_codec.maps: the complete active domain, including Present and WDT RootAbsent entries; maps=wdt_files+root_absent
coverage_codec.missing_m2: canonical ordered unique nonzero WMO doodad M2 FileDataIds after Coverage.maps and before artifacts; direct ADT M2 IDs are never included

strict_wrappers.foreign_or_mixed_masks: rejected by each profile-specific verify and verify-links wrapper before coverage acceptance
strict_wrappers.shared_mask17: sharing mask 17 does not permit crossing layout version, WDT/M2 policy, missing_m2 list, coverage path, source or coverage profile, domain closure, selection, or publication profile
strict_wrappers.zero_selection_aliases: requested_map=0 and MapSelection::MapAndAncestors(0) are rejected and never treated as MapSelection::All

context.binding: The v31 coverage and package contexts must match each other and the canonical PLAN, including RCVGEO1 v4, DeclareRootAbsent WDT, DeclareRootAbsentWmoDoodadM2, canonical missing_m2, model-root-omissions profiles, MapSelection::All and mask 17. v30/All remains v3 with M2 Reject; zero omissions does not change either version.

source_policy.db2_map: Publish exactly canonical Map FDID 1349477 through the disabled-key build-70450 available-source route with structural, exact partial-extent and zero-fill checks.
source_policy.partial_sections: Use v26/v27 declared-skip rules for Map. Declarations remain per table and no decryption or key material is admitted.
source_policy.vmap_map_projection: Read sealed Map with read_vmap_maps_70450 and materialize its VMap projection. Re-derive sections and direct/copy/materialized facts. WDT==0 rows participate in graph/materialization but not active_maps or ROOT omission lists.
source_policy.domain: Build Maps::from_materialized_selection over the complete graph with MapSelection::All. Coverage contains every active map and never adds IDs hidden by omitted Map sections.
source_policy.wdt_root_absence: Only WDT MissingFile followed by guarded raw-ROOT zero-row proof may produce RootAbsent. WDT==0, omitted Map rows, ineligible ROOT, central/encoding absence and corruption are not such proof.
source_policy.model_root_absence: Only a WMO doodad M2 requested by FileDataId while converting a present WMO, with guarded root_has_no_rows(id) before child acquisition, may be declared under run::MissingModelPolicy::DeclareRootAbsentWmoDoodadM2. Each WMO child increments dependency_requests, not top-level request_calls. A declared child has zero child model_reads and is deduplicated in missing_m2; direct ADT M2 requests are never eligible and are not filtered.
fatal_not_model_absence: direct ADT M2 Target::FileDataId even when raw ROOT has zero rows
M2 Target::Name or any logical-name request
WMO root or WMO group absence or malformed data
M2 with ROOT present but ineligible, central CKey absent, encoding absent or corrupt
invalid associations, input guard changes and resource-limit failures
source_policy.omitted_model_effects: An omitted WMO doodad has zero child model_reads and no model handle, VMO, NameBinding, valid name or spawn. The WMO root VMO and WMO placement are preserved, present doodads retain their VMOs/bindings/spawns, and missing_m2 is ordered, unique and bounded by the existing model ceiling.
source_policy.root_absent_map_effects: Skip WDT parser, globals, processing, placements, model requests, IDs, cache and callbacks for WDT ROOT-absent maps while retaining their active graph/coverage entries.
source_policy.present_effects: Present maps retain strict acquisition. Present empty maps have tree and empty proof; populated maps have exact artifacts for every retained WMO and doodad placement. report.maps includes all active maps and report.wdt_files counts present WDT inputs.
source_policy.parent_replay: If the immediate parent is WDT ROOT-absent, do not publish or verify parent-only inheritance and do not skip to a populated grandparent. A child with its own WDT and payload continues without inheritance.
source_policy.root_absence_authentication: producer_reported; offline verification cannot independently reproduce raw ROOT absence for WDT inputs.
source_policy.model_absence_authentication: producer_reported; offline verification cannot independently prove WMO-doodad ROOT absence or reconstruct the original omitted doodad requests and spawns.
source_policy.source_authentication_flags: CKey/EKey acquisition facts are producer-reported, not independent cryptographic source authentication.
source_policy.gameobjects: GODI and global GameObject startup are excluded by profile policy. No GameObjectDisplayInfo request or GameObjectModels.dtree output is admitted.
source_policy.models: Preserve the present WMO root VMO and WMO placement, and every present doodad VMO/NameBinding/valid name/spawn. used_models and VMO inventory contain only present models; an omitted WMO doodad contributes none of them and no placement spawn.
source_policy.liquids: LiquidMaterial and LiquidType retain complete strict checks. LiquidObject is out of scope and is not requested.
source_policy.failure_policy: Only separately proven WDT ROOT and WMO-doodad M2/FDID ROOT absences are declarable. Direct ADT M2, WMO roots/groups, names, ADT, conversion/no-collision results and every other source, graph, placement, model, association or limit failure remains fatal and never becomes an empty map or omission.

verification.verify_scope: offline package integrity, per-table Map declarations, independently re-derived Map sections and graph, present-map artifacts and associations, exact present-model inventory, and declared WDT/M2 omission boundaries
verification.verify_links_scope: the same v31 checks; no terrain, navigation, MMap or external package links
independently_derived_facts: Map section availability/admission and per-table partial declarations
VMap declared/direct/copy/materialized counts and ordered identities
complete materialized graph, active IDs, parents, depths, WDT FDIDs and MapEntry::is_parent
maps=wdt_files+root_absent and absence of artifacts for WDT-omitted maps
exact used_models/VMO inventory and absence of omitted WMO-doodad names, bindings, valid names and spawns from every placement proof
producer_reported_facts: raw ROOT absence for each declared WDT FDID
raw ROOT absence and original doodad request/spawn filtering for each missing_m2 FDID
zero child model_reads for each declared WMO doodad
verification.offline_limit: Offline verification cannot prove raw ROOT absence or reconstruct original omitted WMO-doodad requests and spawns. It checks canonical declarations and all package-visible boundaries but those source facts remain producer-reported.
verification.missing_m2_canonical: ordered, unique and nonzero WMO doodad FDIDs; reject duplicates, zero, unsorted IDs, direct ADT M2 IDs and policies other than DeclareRootAbsentWmoDoodadM2
verification.omitted_model_name: FILE{id:08X}.xxx; reject its VMO, NameBinding, valid name, spawn and every placement reference

facts: every active map with WDT root_absent state and maps=wdt_files+root_absent
canonical ordered unique missing_m2 WMO doodad FDIDs with no VMO, NameBinding, valid name, spawn or placement references
present WMO root VMO and WMO placement plus present doodad VMOs/bindings/spawns retained in the same source tile
zero child model_reads for each declared WMO doodad
Map sections, direct/copy/materialized facts and per-table declarations independently re-derived
WDT==0 graph rows excluded from active_maps and both omission lists
present empty maps with mandatory tree and empty proof
no parent-only inheritance through a WDT ROOT-absent immediate parent
GODI/global GameObjects and LiquidObject excluded without requests
WDT/model ROOT absence and CKey/EKey acquisition flags remain producer_reported

limits.package_files_scope: 65,536 files includes Map.db2 and RCVGEO1 coverage; all ceilings apply simultaneously
limits.missing_m2_limit: min(placements.max_models, collector.max_models); each new declaration must satisfy len < both limits before push and return Error::Limit on excess before further callbacks
limits.missing_m2_capacity: reserve before acquisition; no reallocation beyond the reservation or uncharged vector growth; Completed::resident_bytes charges actual root_absent and missing_m2 capacities
limits.partial_frames_scope: The total retains the v26/v27 ceiling across selected tables, including Map; the per-table ceiling is the existing CASC max_blte_frames limit and is not raised.
limits.partial_frame_coverage: One or more E frames must exactly tile every ordered TACT-declared extent of Map; crossing, missing, extra or inconsistent coverage rejects.
limits.package_total_bytes_equation: checked_add(collision-output-bytes, 17179869184) where 17179869184 is the 16 GiB DB2 ceiling; overflow rejects
limits.meaning: All seven plan budgets and every product ceiling are downward-only. The 128 MiB aggregate, 128 MiB placement, 384 MiB model, 4096-map/model, 65535-coverage-artifact and 65536-package-file ceilings are not raised. The package ceiling is checked_add(collision-output-bytes, 17179869184). No output is truncated and state remains provisional until sealed.

accept canonical esES all.tsv with exact roundtrip; all seven 1048576 budgets are synthetic and not certified real budgets

retain every prior numeric ceiling including 128 MiB aggregate, 128 MiB placements, 384 MiB models, 4096 maps/models, 65535 coverage artifacts and 65536 package files including Map+coverage; use checked_add(collision-output-bytes, 17179869184); enforce the lower placement/collector model limit before each omission with Error::Limit and no uncharged reallocation or further callbacks

v22/v28 keep v1, v29 keeps v2, v30 keeps v3 with M2 Reject and every prior strict route remains unchanged

real_acceptance.note: The real v31 extraction failed at the bounded top-level request ceiling. No final package, offline package verification, accepted prefix or runtime acceptance is claimed.

excluded: decryption, key discovery or key use
complete DB2 content or whole-client DB2 coverage claims
whole-client, full-world or complete VMap component coverage claims
direct ADT M2 by FDID or logical name, WMO roots, WMO groups or ADT as declarable omissions
ROOT present ineligible, central/encoding absent, corruption, malformed source or conversion/no-collision as ROOT absence
VMO, NameBinding, valid name, spawn, placement, model handle or serial ID for an omitted WMO doodad M2
tree, proof, tile or model artifacts for WDT ROOT-absent maps
inventing hidden, inactive, WDT==0 or unknown IDs as active or omitted resources
parent-only inheritance through ROOT-absent or substitution from a grandparent
requested_map=0 or MapSelection::MapAndAncestors(0) as an all-map selection alias
global or foreign partial-section manifest declarations
GODI/global GameObject startup models and GameObjectModels.dtree
